findings.location: Luke 2:8–14 quotation and its repetition in the “A Song” section
findings.source_quote: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the printed wording as goodwill toward people, without adding the claim that they are people God loves; for example: “Ära åt Gud i höjden och frid på jorden, välvilja mot människor.” Make the same correction in both quotations.
findings.translation_quote: “Ära åt Gud i höjden och frid på jorden, till människor som han älskar”
